title: reading first: docs (queries.mdx) say the SQL driver ignores a structured groupBy alias, while skills/objectstack-query says the column keys come out right either way — one is wrong for at least one dialect
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6963684419). The dev on #34597 (PR #35012) noted it, and the seat's contract review on that PR confirmed it has no carrier.

## The contradiction
- `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` says the SQL driver **ignores** a structured `groupBy` alias.
- `skills/objectstack-query` says the column keys come out correct **either way**.
- One of the two is wrong for at least one dialect.

## Done when
A run on SQLite and on PostgreSQL shows what a structured `groupBy` alias returns. Whichever text is wrong, docs or skill, is then corrected and held by a pin or an eval case. If the driver is what is wrong, that is filed as its own card with a grade.

Grade: **p2 · domain:skills**, reading first. Theme: MCP. External agents write grouped queries from the skill, and a wrong promise yields wrong column keys in their answers. No customer is named.
